posts.name: Martin Tenbones
posts.cooked:
I mean, I can definitely see how mechanically strong Fangs and Minds make each other with a smooth mix of offense, defense, mobility, and much easier access to non-Jungle lands for Fangs, but I still feel something is missing without Trickster.  Fangs and Minds working together, Invaders are all like, "And then our supply lines were ambushed from both sides simultaneously by packs of tigers.  We left the men to fight while the officers retreated in order not to miss tea, we're still waiting to hear back from them.  I say, were tigers always pack hunters and we just didn't realize it?"  But adding Trickster in, it's "Well, no, I don't think they were pack hunters when we were on campaign in India... wait, who is that at the door?  Grandma?  Is that you?  Why, you've come all the way from England on holiday to visit me, what a lovely surprise!  But what big eyes you have, and what big teeth, and wha... oh dear God, no!!!"

Moral: It's the *unexpected* tigers that'll get ya.
